text:
Alex R.: heads-up — scheduling payment-service v2 deploy to prod in the 15:00 UTC release slot on 2024-05-12. Need smoke owner, rollback owner, and a quick preflight checklist. Target canary: 10% for 10m then ramp. Anyone take ownership?

deploy-bot: slot 15:00 UTC reserved by @Alex R. (slot id: slot-20240512-15).

Priya S.: I'll own smoke monitoring and post-deploy checks. Will watch traces/5xx and latency for the first 15m. @Maya T. - can you run the smoke test script?

Maya T.: On it. I'll run smoke suite at 15:05. smoke command: ./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod --service=payment-service --tests=critical. I'll post results here.

Jamal K.: I'll be the deploy lead. Deploy plan: pre-migration at 14:50 to run db migration job in dry mode, then deploy at 15:00. Migration: `pg-migrate apply --service payments --mode=online` (has reversible migration). Canary config: traffic split 10% -> 90% over 10m. Rollback plan: revert release tag + run `pg-migrate rollback --to=prev` if migration fails. If bad, revert traffic and rollback app.

Lin W.: Frontend has two feature flags for new checkout flow. I'll keep ff_checkout_v2=false during canary and toggle to true after full ramp. Ping me if I need to toggle earlier.

Priya S.: Smoke checklist (short):
- traces panel (service:payment)
- 5xx rate <0.1% over 5m
- median latency <350ms
- background job lag <30s
- stripe requests success 200s
I'll post timestamps and dashboard links.

Alex R.: Perf dashboard: https://console.redwood/dev/dashboards/payment-service?slot=slot-20240512-15 — update rollout doc pls: /runbooks/payment-service/release-2024-05-12

Maya T.: Smoke results: all green except one 502 on checkout API at 15:07 — looks transient, retry succeeded. Full log: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood/payment/health` returned 200 after retry.

Priya S.: Marking smoke PASS at 15:12. Observability: spikes in tail latency at 15:02 but settled by 15:10.

Jamal K.: If we need emergency rollback:
1) Pause traffic: `route-control set-split payment-service 100%:old`
2) Deploy previous image tag: `deployctl promote payment-service:v1.38`
3) Run rollback migration if needed.
I'll be ready on pager channel.

Alex R.: Thanks team. I'll annotate runbook and set canary window to 10m in the console. @Lin W. please confirm ff toggle when ready. :thumbsup:

Lin W.: Will toggle ff at 15:25 once full ramp done. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: reminder: canary window ends at 15:10 UTC. Monitoring alarms will escalate at 15:20 if thresholds breached.

Alex R.: All set. Closing thread — update here if anything changes. GL everyone.
